methods.name: advance
methods.summary: Increases the number of elements in the internal buffer by `n` and resizes the buffer as needed.

methods.name: append
methods.summary: Appends a value of type `T` into the builder, growing the internal buffer as needed.

methods.name: append_n
methods.signature: fn append_n(&mut self, n: usize, v: T)
methods.summary: Appends a value of type `T` into the builder N times, growing the internal buffer as needed.

methods.name: append_slice
methods.summary: Appends a slice of type `T`, growing the internal buffer as needed.

methods.name: append_trusted_len_iter
methods.signature: unsafe fn append_trusted_len_iter(&mut self, iter: impl IntoIterator<Item = T>)
methods.summary: # Safety This requires the iterator be a trusted length. This could instead require the iterator implement `TrustedLen` once that is stabilized.

methods.name: as_slice
methods.summary: View the contents of this buffer as a slice

methods.name: as_slice_mut
methods.summary: View the contents of this buffer as a mutable slice

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Builds an immutable [Buffer] without resetting the builder.

methods.name: capacity
methods.summary: Returns the actual capacity (number of elements) of the internal buffer.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(&mut self, iter: I)

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Resets this builder and returns an immutable [Buffer].

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(iter: I) -> Self

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns whether the internal buffer is empty.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the current number of array elements in the internal buffer.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new builder with initial capacity for _at least_ `capacity` elements of type `T`.

methods.name: new_from_buffer
methods.summary: Creates a new builder from a [`MutableBuffer`]

methods.name: reserve
methods.summary: Reserves memory for _at least_ `n` more elements of type `T`.
